Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory with detailed site profiles and condition assessments across all major systems including HVAC, roofing, plumbing, electrical, and security; uses multiple data sources including facility audits and engineering assessments; connects condition data to long-term capital planning and educational priorities (Exhibits A-F, Facility Condition Index, pages 20-85).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Provides detailed 10-year enrollment projections using multiple cohort survival models with explanation of methodology; includes detailed capacity analysis by school with state and district standards; connects enrollment projections to facility needs and capacity utilization; discusses demographic trends and residential development impacts (pages 15-37).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational specifications are a core organizing principle with detailed descriptions of facility requirements for various programs including TK, CTE, special education, STEM, arts, and collaborative learning; clear integration of district mission, instructional priorities, and facilities planning; facility projects respond directly to educational needs (Exhibit B, pages 13-74).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Includes data and analysis of outdoor spaces with references to playgrounds, fields, and shade structures; identifies strategies for improvement such as shade structures and playground resurfacing; mentions outdoor learning spaces and community use but lacks districtwide detailed data on green surfaces or climate resilience framing (Facility Advisory Committee recommendations, site profiles).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges climate-related issues indirectly through energy efficiency and facility maintenance but lacks a detailed climate risk assessment or comprehensive climate resilience strategies; no districtwide climate readiness theme evident (no explicit climate risk assessment or mitigation strategies found).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: References energy efficiency projects including HVAC upgrades, LED lighting, and solar panels via Proposition 39 funding; includes some data on energy use and energy-related improvements; mentions energy resilience goals but lacks comprehensive districtwide electrification or microgrid strategies (pages 43-47, Prop 39 funding).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents a comprehensive financial plan including detailed funding sources such as local bonds (Propositions V and L), state grants, developer fees, and Prop 39; includes fund balances, prioritization of projects, and alignment with district educational priorities; discusses long-term financial sustainability and capital improvement planning (pages 43-50).
